name: cc-agents-kit
description: Guardrails and workflow tooling for Claude Code, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: Seven defensive hooks: blocks recursive rm on $HOME, download-and-execute pipelines, secrets-file access, path-less formatter runs, credentials in the staged diff, and the two zsh quoting mistakes that fail silently; warns on stale lockfiles and shellcheck findings.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Carry work across sessions and keep the context that carries it lean: hand off a session, export or log what it found, chart an effort too big for one sitting, and audit or garbage-collect your Claude Code config.

plugins.name: repo-gate
plugins.description: What runs between "the code works" and "it is pushed": trunk setup, conventional-commit splitting, dependency vulnerability triage, spell-check triage, and babysitting CI until it is green.
